ads.headline: If you have a shelf of half-finished bottles and something is still…
ads.primaryText:
If you have a shelf of half-finished bottles and something is still not right, read this before you buy the next one.

I am about to tell you why the probiotics did not do it, why the glutamine powder did not do it, and where the part you can actually feel has been sitting this whole time.

By the end of this you are going to be relieved. Because you were never doing it wrong.

My name is Paula. I am 52.

I spent six years doing everything right for my gut.

I want to be honest about what that does to a person, because this one is different. Nobody dismissed me. Nobody told me it was in my head. I was not fighting for anyone to believe me.

I did the work. That is what makes it hard to talk about.

I read everything. I know what mucilage is. I know what a CFU is. I can tell you which probiotic strains need refrigeration and which ones do not, off the top of my head, right now.

I took L-glutamine powder, five grams a day, every morning, for two years without missing one.

Collagen in my coffee. Bone broth on the stove every Sunday for six years. Enough different probiotics that I could rank them.

I did the elimination diet. Gluten first. Then dairy. Then nightshades. Then FODMAPs. By the end I had nine foods and a spreadsheet.

I paid four hundred dollars out of pocket, twice, to sit with a functional medicine practitioner. Not covered. I did the stool test. I did the food sensitivity panel and got back a forty-seven page PDF that told me I was reactive to broccoli.

I have a shelf. You know the shelf. Half-finished bottles, three of the same thing in different brands, and one in the back from 2021 I am afraid to look at.

At some point I started having them shipped to my office so I would not have to say the number out loud.

And here is the part I still think about.

My husband stopped asking how the new one was going.

He did not do it to be unkind. He did it because he had asked me forty times and every single time I said I think it is helping. And we both heard it.

I could recite the ingredients in nine bottles. I still felt puffy and off by 3pm most days.

That is what six years of doing everything right looks like.

I want you to really hear this next part, because it took me six years to find it.

Your gut lining is not one spot. It is a run. One continuous sheet of tissue, starting the second you swallow, all the way through. Everybody who talks about "leaky gut" is talking about that lining doing its job of holding things where they belong.

Here is what I finally learned, and I learned it from research, not from any practitioner I ever paid.

Probiotics work on what is living in your gut. Glutamine powder gets absorbed early and moves on. An elimination diet removes what might be aggravating things. All useful. None of them are built to actually sit on the lining itself and stay there.

I could feel exactly where my problem was; I just never gave anything a way to stay put long enough to work on it.

My protocol was probably doing something. Just not the part I could feel.

It was never that I was doing it wrong. It was that nothing I took was built to cling to the lining instead of passing through it.

So I went looking for something with actual contact time. Not another capsule that dissolves and disperses. Not another powder that behaves like water. Something with ingredients meant to coat and stay.

That is when I found the eleven.

Slippery elm and marshmallow root are mucilage herbs — they go slick and cling to the lining instead of running past it.

DGL licorice and aloe help calm irritated tissue on contact.

Sodium alginate is gel-forming; it helps form a light layer rather than washing straight through.

Zinc-L-Carnosine and L-glutamine are there to help support the lining itself, where it has to do its job.

Coat. Calm. Cover. Support. Eleven ingredients working together, not eleven ingredients doing one job.

I found a small U.S. brand called NanoRevive that had put all eleven into one bottle, called EsoRepair.

It is a liquid you take with a dropper. A few drops under the tongue, hold about thirty seconds, then swallow slowly so it moves down and coats along the way. Nano-sized particles, so they're designed to settle in rather than slide straight past.

I want to be clear about one thing, because I am not going to insult you.

I did not stop my probiotics or my glutamine. This was never a replacement for six years of work. I am not telling you your protocol was a waste. I am telling you it may have had a gap in it — nothing was staying in contact with the lining long enough to help.

I started taking it.

Week one, less of that puffy, "off" feeling by afternoon. I told myself not to get excited. I have been excited before.

Week two, I was not imagining it. I ate something that used to bother me and nothing happened.

Week three, my husband asked what the new one was. Not how it was going. What it was. He had not asked in three years.

Week four, I put a food back. On purpose. Permanently.

I am not going to tell you it happened overnight, because it did not. But for the first time in six years it was moving, and it was moving once I gave something a way to actually stay on the lining instead of just passing through.

Here is what I want you to take from a 52-year-old woman who spent six years feeding her gut everything except something that would stay long enough to help.

If you have done everything right and something is still not right, you are probably not missing a better version of what you already own. You may be missing something built to cling, not just pass through.

The formula I use is EsoRepair by NanoRevive.

They back it with a 90-day money-back guarantee. Take it. If it does nothing for you, you get your money back.

The woman standing in front of that shelf at eleven at night already knows something is missing. She has just been looking for it in the wrong place. I know, because I stood there for six years.

You have time. Do it now.

https://nano-revive.com/pages/gut-lining 90-day money-back guarantee. Cancel a subscription anytime.
